honest_residue_for_scope_lock_section_15: 1. v1 substrate ships TORCH_CUBLASLT_DISABLE=1 via CDI env. Effective for bf16 + fp16 (LLM dtypes; routes through cublasGemmEx). Ineffective for fp32 (torch 2.11 ignores the env for fp32; cublasLtSSSMatmul via algo-fn-pointer bypasses substrate). v2 driver-API-level interception eliminates this gap.

2. v1 cuBLAS-Lt substrate-visibility for code that uses documented cuBLAS-Lt API (dlsym-based callers) is comprehensive (17 variant trampolines + umbrella). Real-world torch uses an undocumented algo-fn-pointer shortcut that bypasses; v2 closes.
3. v1 cuBLAS-Lt actuator dispatch (Marlin/Koopman/VOLT routing on Lt calls) deferred to v1.x. Requires cublasLtMatrixLayoutGetAttribute M/N/K decoder + opaque algo struct introspection.
4. v1 substrate is CUDA-13-linked; host running cipher-platform CLI verify must use file-sanity check (not ctypes.CDLL) because host may not have CUDA 13 runtime libs.
5. Koopman device-stub Phase E pre-flight gate carried (validates Koopman tier nvcc 12.8 -> 13.0 emission equivalence for CIPHER_KOOPMAN=1 path).
6. libc10 ABI portability: container's libc10.so md5 b814a98f = host's = .deb's. Future PyTorch image refresh may change libc10 ABI; cipher-platform verify would surface.
